title: Staging Backup Broker independently isolated host candidate (no admin authority)

phases.objective: Offer an opt-in isolated, credential-free Staging Broker process candidate while preserving unconditional administrative fail-closed behavior.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Validate a Docker Compose opt-in preflight profile and read-only host discovery under certified exact Staging source
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Sandbox candidate remains non-admin and cannot be mistaken for an independently approved Broker.
steps: Validate isolated Docker-internal network and runtime-db existing app network continuity.
Verify no published port, host mount, socket, privileged user, Linux capability, or accepted owner/DBA approval.
Run read-only broker discovery for missing, unsafe and observed candidate and check it never certifies administrative authority.
Inspect Staging Compose overlay with --profile backup-broker-preflight config --quiet without activating the profile.
assertions: Source code requires explicit opt-in; standard Auto Deploy does not include this overlay.
No database account/SQL, real backup, restore, Production mutation or signing key is exposed.
Candidate sandbox observation does not imply Broker operational attestation, Ed25519 signature or DBA authority.
Shared Local Connector code is explicitly reviewed for Staging and Production; Production mutation remains false.
